title: racoon AI provenance attestation (RFC 0005 "provpaws")
description: The accountable human's approval of the commits of one AI-assisted session. Written by `prov attest`, committed in a signed approval commit at .provenance/attestations/<YYYY>/<provenance_id>/<attested>.json. Binds to the reviewed content by `git patch-id --stable`, so it survives rebase but not a change to any reviewed diff. Immutable once merged; further commits of the same session get a further attestation file.

reviewer.description: E-mail address of the accountable human. Must equal the signing principal of the approval commit.

attested.description: UTC time of attestation; equals the file name stem.

patch_id.description: git patch-id --stable of the reviewed commit.

tests.description: Evidence for reviewed-and-tested: the command prov attest ran on the attested tree, its exit status and a digest of its output.
